title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming EU anti-corruption strategy
part_context: Notes that measures affecting the execution of sanctions in corruption-related cases, such as pardons, amnesties, commutation of sentences, early or conditional release, or the non-execution of confiscation orders, require particular care to avoid undermining the effectiveness of sanctions, weakening deterrence and eroding public trust in the equal application of the law; recommends that, where such measures are applied, they be subject to clear, objective and transparent criteria and duly reasoned decisions made publicly available; underlines that a shared culture of integrity across the EU remains central to the effectiveness of anti-corruption policies; calls for increased transparency concerning foreign-funded think tanks, consultancies and corporate lobbies engaged in EU policy processes, as part of safeguards against covert foreign interference and undue influence;
